issues.description: The template's addGuestStudents method signature has an extra boolean parameter (addGuestStudents(int, boolean)) which contradicts the problem statement/UML and the solution implementation that declare addGuestStudents(int). This parameter mismatch will confuse students about which signature to implement and prevents them from matching the expected method used in tests and the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }. If additional validation behavior is desired, implement it inside this method or provide an overloaded private helper (e.g., private void addGuestStudents(int, boolean)) so the public API matches the UML and problem statement.

Alternatively, provide an overloaded version that delegates to the single-parameter method, but prefer aligning the template signature to the specified API to avoid student confusion.
